allocated_connections.Description: A list of connections allocated for the Gateway.

ingress_port.Description: The ingress port of an allocated connection.

psc_uri.Description: The PSC uri of an allocated connection.

display_name.Description: An arbitrary user-provided name for the AppGateway.

effective_labels.Description: All of labels (key/value pairs) present on the resource in GCP, including the labels configured through Terraform, other clients and services.

host_type.Description: The type of hosting used by the AppGateway. Default value: "HOST_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED" Possible values: ["HOST_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED", "GCP_REGIONAL_MIG"]

labels.Description:
Resource labels to represent user provided metadata.


**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_labels' for all of the labels present on the resource.

state.Description: Represents the different states of a AppGateway.

terraform_labels.Description:
The combination of labels configured directly on the resource
 and default labels configured on the provider.

type.Description: The type of network connectivity used by the AppGateway. Default value: "TYPE_UNSPECIFIED" Possible values: ["TYPE_UNSPECIFIED", "TCP_PROXY"]
